Technical SEO.title: Google Updates Crawled - Currently Not Indexed Details
Technical SEO.summary: Google revised its page indexing report documentation for the Crawled - Currently Not Indexed status, clarifying that Google does not index all pages, that this message is common, and that it does not necessarily indicate a site issue.

Technical SEO.title: Only Home Page Indexed? Might Be A Google Search Quality Issue
Technical SEO.summary: If a site's previously indexed pages are no longer appearing in Google's index and only the home page remains indexed, Google indicates this may reflect a Search quality issue with the website itself.

Technical SEO.title: Google Performance Reports Showing Weird Spike In Clicks For Some Sites
Technical SEO.summary: Google Search Console's performance report is displaying an anomalous spike in clicks for some sites over recent days, though not all sites are affected and the cause may be a reporting bug.

Technical SEO.title: Google On How To Block Popups Using Robot.txt In Search
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller explained a method for preventing JavaScript-based pop-up dialogs from appearing in Google Search results by using the robots.txt file to block the relevant resources.

Technical SEO.title: Google Says It's Okay To Block Some JavaScript Resources With Robots.txt
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller confirmed that it is acceptable, within a specific use case, to use robots.txt to prevent Googlebot from accessing certain JavaScript resources.

Technical SEO.title: Rank Trackers Find Google Results About One Word Of A Query
Technical SEO.summary: Rank tracker data is surfacing Google results that appear to match only a single word of a multi-word query, mostly below the top-ranked positions, which can mislead ranking reports and requires manual verification.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Q3 2026 Earnings Call: Search & AI Are Merging Into One Unified Product
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: During its Q3 2026 earnings call, Google signaled that Search is evolving into an agent manager and that rapid improvement driven by recursive self-improvement is expected, effectively merging Search and AI into one product.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI traffic drives 83% more revenue per visit
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Adobe research found that visitors arriving via AI-referred traffic generated 83% more revenue per visit than non-AI traffic, and also converted 90% better.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Building A Global Content Factory With AI (Without Losing The Human Touch)
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article outlines a framework for scaling AI-generated content across global markets by grounding each market's pages in approved facts, local evidence, and human editorial judgment to preserve local relevance.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Search Volume Is About 5x ChatGPT's, OpenAI Says
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI stated that ChatGPT's search-like queries amount to roughly one-fifth of Google's search volume, counting each question that sends the model to the web, though third-party traffic data differs from this figure.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Ad Tags In Server-Side GTM To Get Full IP Addresses
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google announced that ad tags running in server-side Tag Manager will receive full IP addresses while Analytics tags remain redacted, introducing a distinction that affects measurement and privacy configurations for enterprise setups.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Every OpenAI Publisher Partnership, and How Often ChatGPT Cites Them
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Ahrefs maps every publisher that has licensed content to OpenAI, explaining that each deal generally involves ChatGPT surfacing summaries with attribution and links back to the source, making these publishers among the most visible sites in AI-generated answers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Which Types of Mentions Correlate the Strongest With AI Visibility? (260M AI Prompts Analyzed)
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs analyzed 260 million AI prompts to compare how different brand mention types correlate with visibility in AI-generated answers, building on prior research that examined web mentions, anchor text, search volume, and referring domains.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode Biased: It Only Shows Links To Google Flights
AI Search / GEO.summary: Testing of Google AI Mode for flight queries showed that 100% of links surfaced within AI Mode responses pointed exclusively to Google Flights, raising potential Digital Markets Act concerns in Europe for travel and OTA competitors.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews For Brands Move To Right Column
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has moved AI Overviews for brand-related searches out of the main results column and into the right-hand column of the search results page, altering how branded query visibility appears in the SERP layout.

AI Search / GEO.title: November 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update Done, AI Overviews, Help Docs, Local & Earnings
AI Search / GEO.summary: The November 2026 Google Webmaster Report from Search Engine Roundtable covers the completion of a spam update alongside developments in AI Overviews, updated help documentation, local search, and earnings commentary.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Tests Removing AI Mode Button From Search Bar
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is reportedly testing the removal of the AI Mode button from the main Search bar for a small subset of users, in what appears to be a comparative performance experiment.

AI Search / GEO.title: The 25 Best AEO/GEO Experts to Follow in 2026
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs compiled a list of 25 practitioners publishing original research on AI search and generative engine optimization, intended as a curated resource for staying current with how AI answer surfaces are evolving.
